note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Divergence-gap error analysis of flow matching motivates the FDM objective and its empirical gains

nodes.name: CFM regresses a conditional vector field
nodes.description: Conditional flow matching trains v_t(x,theta) against a conditional vector field per data sample, and L_CFM equals the FM loss up to a constant independent of theta, so it is an unbiased estimate of the marginal field.

nodes.name: CFM leaves a large divergence gap
nodes.description: Even when CFM regresses the vector field, the divergence gap |div v_t - div u_t| can be substantial, producing significant errors in the learned probability path and likelihood estimates (Fig 1).

nodes.name: PDE for the path error
nodes.description: The error eps_t = p_t - p_hat_t satisfies a continuity-type PDE with initial value 0 and a forcing term L_t = -p_t[div(u_t - v_t) + (u_t - v_t).grad log p_t] (Proposition 3.1).

nodes.name: Divergence gap matters as much as vector-field gap
nodes.description: The solution of the error PDE (Corollary 3.2) shows that minimizing the divergence gap is as important as reducing the vector-field discrepancy for learning an accurate probability path.

nodes.name: TV bound via divergence loss
nodes.description: Under mild assumptions, TV(p_t, p_hat_t) <= (1/2) L_DM(theta) for any t, so p_t = p_hat_t when L_DM is zero (Theorem 3.3).

nodes.name: Divergence loss is intractable directly
nodes.description: The marginal divergence loss cannot be minimized directly because the divergence of the marginal vector field is unavailable.

nodes.name: Conditional divergence matching bound
nodes.description: The conditional divergence loss L_CDM upper-bounds L_DM and gives TV(p_t, p_hat_t) <= (1/2) L_CDM (Theorem 4.1).

nodes.name: L_CDM alone is insufficient
nodes.description: Minimizing L_CDM alone gives no guarantee of proximity between v_t and u_t because its two terms can cancel and the loss cannot reach exactly zero.

nodes.name: FDM objective
nodes.description: Flow and divergence matching trains with L_FDM = lambda1 L_CFM + lambda2 L_CDM, directly controlling the gap between vector fields and between their divergences.

nodes.name: FDM is cheaper than higher-order methods
nodes.description: L_FDM is computationally cheaper than controlling higher-order quantities such as the gradient of the divergence, and an efficient variant uses stop-gradient and Hutchinson trace estimation.

nodes.name: Synthetic mixture shows FDM improves the path
nodes.description: On a 1D Gaussian mixture with a 3-layer MLP on VP path, FDM (lambda2=0.2) learns the probability path closer to the data than FM (lambda2=0) (Fig 2).

nodes.name: Checkerboard likelihood improves
nodes.description: On the checkerboard test set FDM improves likelihood over FM for both OT (2.53 vs 2.38) and VP (2.46 vs 2.34) paths (Table 1).

nodes.name: CIFAR-10 NLL and FID improve
nodes.description: On CIFAR-10 FDM(OT) improves NLL from 2.99 to 2.85 and FID from 6.35 to 5.62 over FM(OT) (Table 2).

nodes.name: DNA generation improves
nodes.description: FDM improves FM with Linear and Dirichlet probability paths for promoter DNA sequence generation, with and without guidance (Tables 3-4).

nodes.name: Dynamical-system trajectories improve
nodes.description: FDM outperforms FM and diffusion on event-guided trajectory sampling, with lower KL divergence between event-constraint histograms (Table 7), without hurting estimation of p(E).

nodes.name: Video prediction improves
nodes.description: FDM improves latent FM on KTH and BAIR video prediction, keeping high visual quality in later frames where FM loses motion details (Tables 8-9, Fig 6).

isolated_nodes.name: FDM and diffusion models
isolated_nodes.description: Diffusion models with VP or VE SDEs are special cases of flow-based generative models with diffusion paths.

isolated_nodes.name: Higher-order score matching is costlier
isolated_nodes.description: Higher-order score-matching methods for diffusion models are significantly more computationally expensive than FDM.

isolated_nodes.name: No prior PDE error bound
isolated_nodes.description: To the authors' knowledge, a PDE characterization of the error between exact and learned probability paths and a TV bound using only the vector field and its divergence had not been considered in the literature.

isolated_nodes.name: KL control left for future work
isolated_nodes.description: Controlling the KL divergence between probability paths in a computationally efficient way is left for future work.

structural_reasoning: Argument runs from the observed divergence gap in CFM, through the PDE error analysis and TV bound, to the tractable conditional divergence loss, the FDM objective and its empirical evaluation.
